title: Potato of Life Canonical Ontology Tree
rule: Branch by function and relationship, not by every available word. A branch becomes a file only when it can support dense independent knowledge.

potato-of-life.meaning: integrated spiritual object and whole relational form

geometry.meaning: the form that makes relation possible

matter.meaning: lower domain and Son-side embodied reality

threshold.meaning: the shared region and transformation between domains

axis.meaning: vertical orientation, structural flow and continuity through the whole form

living-tree.meaning: organic expression of the same geometry

dynamics.meaning: movements and transformations generated by the structure

formalization.meaning: explicit relational and mathematical models used to clarify the system without claiming scientific validation

religion-and-philosophy.meaning: interpretation, practice and teaching derived from the form

journey.meaning: development of the framework through lived and narrated thresholds

comparison.meaning: external traditions used to illuminate and test the internal system

world.meaning: later outward application of relationship-first mapping

shadow-systems.meaning: analytical models of blocked flow, institutional dysfunction, exploitative attention systems and conflict ecologies

archive.meaning: provenance, retrieval, weighting and preservation of the knowledge system itself

creative-works.meaning: games, simulations, music, performance and other creative artifacts that use Potatoverse material without automatically becoming doctrine

axis_reading: The Axis/Ladder/Spine passes continuously through the form. The listed vertical spine is symbolic topology rather than a claim that every motif occupies one rigid Euclidean coordinate.
primary_couplings: Tree of Life ↔ Root of Strife
promotion_rule: Terms in this ontology are navigational concepts, not automatic files. Promote a term into its own canonical record only when its definition, development, relationships, teachings, evidence or literature can no longer be represented clearly inside its parent record.
